claim: Microsoft's fiscal Q2 2026 R&D expense topped $9.2 billion for the first time.
summary: Claim concerns Microsoft fiscal Q2 2026 (quarter ended Dec 31, 2025, reported late Jan 2026). Knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04 precedes earnings release and no tools are available to verify. Therefore whether R&D expense topped $9.2B and whether it was the first time cannot be established from internal knowledge alone.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft fiscal Q2 2026 R&D expense exceeded $9.2 billion
sub_claims.note: Fiscal Q2 2026 ended Dec 31, 2025 and would be reported after knowledge cutoff 2026-01-04. Without tools no verifiable R&D value can be retrieved.

sub_claims.text: Microsoft had never previously reported quarterly R&D expense above $9.2 billion before fiscal Q2 2026
sub_claims.note: First-time-above claim requires complete historical quarterly R&D series to confirm no prior quarter exceeded threshold. Not available without tools and after cutoff.
